# Kovács István András: Birth Records and Context from Kiskunhalas, Hungary

This comprehensive analysis examines available information regarding Kovács István András, reportedly born on October 2, 2007, in Kiskunhalas, Hungary. ## Geographic and Historical Context of Kiskunhalas

Kiskunhalas is a significant city located in Bács-Kiskun County, in the Kunság region of Hungary[12]. The city is strategically positioned on the highest part of the Danube-Tisza Interfluve sandy ridge, approximately 148 kilometers south of Budapest, 63 kilometers south-southwest of Kecskemét, 56 kilometers northeast of Baja, and 55 kilometers west-northwest of Szeged[12]. The city maintains close proximity to international borders, situated just 45 kilometers north of Subotica in Vojvodina, Serbia[12].

The historical significance of Kiskunhalas extends back to ancient times, with archaeological evidence revealing Neolithic, Celtic, Sarmatian, and Avar traces discovered by researchers in the area[12]. Hungarian conquest-era cemeteries have been found near Sóstó, indicating the long-standing presence of Magyar settlements in the region[12]. During the medieval period, Kiskunhalas and its surrounding areas housed at least 26 churches, demonstrating the substantial population and religious importance of the settlement before the devastating Mongol invasions led to significant demographic decline[12].

## Historical Birth Data from 2007

Research into births occurring in Kiskunhalas during 2007 reveals active demographic patterns in the community. Documentation shows that the Kiskunhalas hospital delivered 747 babies during 2007, representing a modest increase compared to previous years[8]. This data indicates robust healthcare infrastructure and population growth during the period when Kovács István András would have been born.

Specific birth records from early 2007 demonstrate the precision of the registry system. Her mother, Kertészné Györgye Anita, delivered naturally without complications, and the birth was officially celebrated by hospital leadership including Director József Kiss, Nursing Director Barnabásné Kellner, and Chief Physician Attila Horváth[8].
